lines: Not good, the sun's getting awfully low. Getting that chocolate might already be hopeless...
Looking for Saika, I had come all the way to a dirt road on the outskirts of the village.
Suddenly there was a tug on my sleeve, and when I turned around...
Thank you so much for the suppowt a few days ago!
The bad memories came back to me. These damn critters, Lilim and Minasaki, had put me through hell before.
What are you doing in a place like this!?
Since you're walking out here all alone on Valentine's Day or whatever, we suddenly thought if we called out to you we could sell you some chocolate at a high pwice.
Right! I mean you are all alone, aren't you, Chief?
Ah, bulls-eye, yeah? Woo-hoo, woo-hoo, all alone! Lonely Fuma!
Shut up!! Mind your own business!!! More importantly, how did you know where I was?
Have you fowgotten about my awesome ability?
Minasaki belonged to a demonic tribe called the "Yatagarasu tribe" or something like that, and had the power to detect the location of living beings she had seen at least once.
Ah... right, now I remember. But still, you managed to get into Gosha, huh.
We told them we belong to your unit and we were able to just come in though...?
Huh!? That means now I'm responsible for you!?
Now, now, don't worry so much about the details.
Fowget about that, come on, buy this chocolate for 10,000 yen. If you do we'll go home.
Who would buy that! No matter how you look at it, that's more like 100 yen chocolate!
Tsk, tsk, tsk. Have you never heard the concept of "value added"?
You'll get chocolate fwom these two beautiful girls, so 10,000 yen is almost fwee, don't you think?
I don't even want it for free. Go home already.
Hngh! What did you say!? Quite arrogant coming from someone like you, Fuma!
You two... will you shut up already...
I felt something roiling deep in my gut. If they wouldn't go home, I guess I would just have to make them leave by force.
Perhaps sensing my anger, the two of them cowered in fright.
Oh? Did he get angry? Did Chief get angry?
Kyaah♪ So scawy!! But we still have our twump card!
They said and noisily pulled out a big box.
If you don't want our chocolate, it's time for a shake and bake!
This is a shake and bake! Hand over all your money!
Ugh!? You were still keeping those!?
Large wasps flew out of the box. Originally living in the Devildom, they were a ferocious species known as Devildomian Wasps.
Chief, you should be quite familiar with how terrifying Devildomian Wasps are.
If you'd wather give up and get shake and baked, now's the time!
